title: 上海高考高分翻译背诵-101-24一模

items.zh: 网络社交并不能代替现实生活。
items.en: Socializing online is no substitute for the real thing.

items.zh: 房租和人力成本依旧是便利店发展面临的最大障碍。
items.en: Rent and labor costs remain the biggest impediments/barriers to convenience store development.

items.zh: 我们要关注的不是孩子们的言语，而是他们在创造性地解决问题的情况下的行动。
items.en: We should focus not on children’s words, but on their actions when they creatively solve problems.

items.zh: 虽然任务艰巨，我们仍愿同合作伙伴一起把“一带一路”打造成应对挑战的合作之路、维护人民健康安全的健康之路、促进社会经济发展的复苏之路。
items.en: Tough as the task is, we stand ready to work with our partners to make the Belt and Road Initiative a path of cooperation to tackle challenges, a path of health to safeguard people’s well-being, and a path of recovery to boost socio-economic development.

proverb.en: It is now back in vogue again.
